brief_gesture_description: The person stands facing forward, then turns to their left (viewer's right) and extends both arms forward. The left arm extends straight out at shoulder height, while the right arm is raised higher with the hand curved downward, as if holding or placing an object into a slot or opening. The person then returns to a neutral standing position facing forward.
